data.gender_notes: Suram is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Suram is recorded with the meaning “Victorious”. Suram is a Hindu name meaning “Victorious”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Suram expresses “Victorious”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.

in_sanskrit.name: Suram
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Victorious
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Suram एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who conquers or overcomes obstacles

in_hindi.name: Suram
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Victorious
in_hindi.long_meaning: Suram एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who conquers or overcomes obstacles

in_tamil.name: Suram
in_tamil.long_meaning: Suram ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। One who conquers or overcomes obstacles

in_telugu.name: Suram
in_telugu.long_meaning: Suram ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। One who conquers or overcomes obstacles

in_marathi.name: Suram
in_marathi.long_meaning: Suram हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who conquers or overcomes obstacles

in_bengali.name: Suram
in_bengali.long_meaning: Suram একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who conquers or overcomes obstacles
